content: Taran kut dawk hoi roum nahanlah ratoumnae
Kathutkung: Devit, Sawl koehoi lungngoum dawk a yawng navah, a sak e la

content.text: Na pahren haw, Oe Cathut, na pahren haw.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, ka hringnae ni na kâuep .
Hete yawthoenae heh a baw hoehroukrak na rathei tâhlip dawk ka kâhro han.
Lathueng Poung Cathut, bangpuengpa na kasakpouhkung,
ka Cathut teh na kaw han.
Kalvan hoi a patoun vaiteh, na rungngang han,
payawp hanlah kakâcainaw hah a yue han. Selah.
Cathut ni lungmanae hoi lawkkatang hah a patoun han.
Ka hringnae heh sendek um doeh ao.
Lungkhueknae hmai ka kang lahun e taminaw um vah ka i.
Ahnimae hânaw teh tahroe hoi palanaw patetlah ao awh.
Ahnimae lai hai kahran e tahloinaw patetlah ao awh.
Oe Cathut, kalvannaw lathueng vah, pholen lah awm haw.
Na bawilennae teh talai van pueng awm lawiseh.
Ka khok hanlah, tamlawk a yangda awh teh, ka hringnae teh a tabut.
Ka hmalah tangkom a tai awh.
Hatei, a lungui vah amamouh letlang a bo awh. Selah.
Ka lungthin teh a cak doeh, Oe Cathut,
ka lungthin teh a cak doeh, pholennae hoi la ka sak han.
Ka bawilennae kâhlaw haw, ratoung hoi tamawinaw kâhlaw awh haw.
Kai ni teh kho ka dai khai han.
Oe BAWIPA, tamimaya koe na pholen han.
Miphun pueng koe nang pholen hoi la ka sak han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, na lungmanae ni kalvan a pha teh,
na lawkkatang ni tâmai a pha.
Oe Cathut, kalvan vah pholen lah awm naseh,
na bawilennae teh talai van pueng awm lawiseh.
